useCase.query:
Add a dialogue system to this {{engine.id}} game. Structure: {{structure}}. Presentation: {{presentation}}.

Requirements:
- Conversations are data files (JSON under a `dialogue/` folder): nodes with `id`, `speaker`, `text`, optional `choices` (`text`, `next`, optional `requires` and `sets` flags) and an end marker. Writers must be able to edit them without touching code. If the project already has localization, store text keys instead of literal text.
- A dialogue runner with no UI code walks the graph, evaluates flags and validates that every `next` points to an existing node, reporting broken links at load time.
- UI: typewriter reveal that completes instantly on the advance input, then advances on the next press; choices selectable with keyboard, mouse and gamepad; player movement paused while dialogue is open.
- Starting a conversation: an interact action near an NPC (Godot: an `Area2D` on the NPC; Phaser: a distance or overlap check), with a small prompt shown when in range.
- Godot: a `DialogueManager` autoload and a `CanvasLayer` UI scene. Phaser: a `DialogueScene` launched on top of the game scene with `scene.launch`, pausing game input while open.
- Write and wire in one sample conversation: {{sample}}.

Finish by running `pixo game verify --steps check,build,run --screenshot --json`. Fix every failing step and run it again; do not re-run unchanged code. Open the screenshot and confirm the change is actually on screen with no error overlay or blank canvas. Report what passed, what failed, and what could not run.
